title: Hearty Fermented Venezuelan Mushroom Empanadas
description: A savory fusion of funky fermented dough and a rich mushroom sofrito base that adheres to sattvic principles without onions or garlic.

ingredients.name: King Oyster mushrooms
ingredients.notes: Finely diced for a meaty texture

instructions: Combine corn meal, whey, salt, and warm water in a large bowl to form a soft dough.
Cover the dough and let it ferment at room temperature for six hours to develop a funky tang.
Heat ghee in a skillet and sauté the mushrooms with ginger and turmeric until browned.
Stir in the coconut aminos to create a rich glaze and simmer until the liquid evaporates.
Divide the fermented dough into ten equal balls and flatten them into thin circles on plastic wrap.
Place a spoonful of the mushroom mixture in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough over the filling and seal the edges firmly using a fork or a bowl edge.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep pan to three hundred fifty degrees Fahrenheit.
Fry the empanadas for four minutes per side until they are golden brown and crispy.
Drain the empanadas on paper towels and serve warm for the best chewy texture.
